minor.issue: Mobile login: when the user (or automation) fills fields before React hydration completes, the fallback form submit (method='post') fires a plain POST which clears fields and no session is created. ActionForm handles onSubmit only after hydration. Consider disabling submit button until hydrated (state flag) or using `useFormStatus` pending guard. Repro consistently in HeadlessChrome mobile view.
